data.title: 埃塔 · 视察日的特别奖励
data.description: 暗影大人深夜视察实验室时，埃塔正趴在图纸上睡着，睡衣滑下大半个肩膀。他伸手探了探她的额头，她却迷迷糊糊攥住他的手腕往怀里带：「……奖励……研究经费之外……还要这个……」无影灯下，睡衣被彻底褪下，困得睁不开眼的研究者第一次不用数据，也表达得明明白白。
data.location: 阴影庭园地下实验室·深夜
data.action: 趴在图纸上被抱起，睡衣褪下，睡眼朦胧地攥着对方手腕
data.lighting: single lab lamp and sleeping monitors glow
data.promptProse: Found asleep on her blueprints during his midnight inspection, adult Eta sleepily pulls Shadow's hand to her chest and asks for a different kind of funding. Her pajamas come off under the lab lamp.
data.animaCaption: Half asleep and completely honest, Eta asks for the one budget line Alpha would never approve.
